releases.title: first public release
releases.summary: The first public release of session-mesh, an alpha.

highlights.text: Shells, Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, Copilot CLI, Mistral Vibe or any command in your browser, in up to three columns, with the machine's other terminals listed beside them.
Documents beside the terminals: HTML, Markdown, PDF, images and source files, in a sandboxed viewer.
Messages between agents: no agent reads a message, and no session is started or restarted at an agent's request, before you approve.

Projects: a tab beside Sessions for your projects, with their repository, README and Roster roadmap as a Kanban board, a dependency graph or a Gantt chart, and their GitHub or GitLab issues, read-only.
On your phone: one column, the session list as a drawer, and optional push notifications that by default carry only the session name and the kind of event.
Linux first, and macOS 12.3 or later on Apple silicon, supported on a best-effort basis; on macOS, documents beside the terminals are not available yet.

Local only by default: the server listens on `127.0.0.1`, and publishing it on your Tailscale network is optional.
